why: Drops the same-slots guard from the stock-loss cue's trigger (issue #230), so a different match that starts with fewer stocks -- three players at 1 after two players at 3 -- fires a loss cue on a slot that lost nothing. It is the guard `announceStatusChange` applies for the same reason (issue #629), restated rather than shared because the cue records every slot that dropped and the announcement speaks one.
